Lieut. Warneford, V.C.

Bowyer Nichols (1859–1939)

(
Iliad,
 xvi. 676–83)
W
HOM
 the gods loved they gave in youth’s first flower
One infinite hour of glory. That same hour,
Before a leaf droops from the laurel, come
Winged Death and Sleep to bear Sarpedon home.
